title: Dispatch CTW 2: The Choir Answers Before a Question Is Sent
summary: A reply arrives six minutes ahead of the message that prompts it.
topic: The Choir in the Telegraph Wires
author: Clara Vale, Staff Correspondent
paragraphs: An Alderwick operator intended to ask Kingsfen whether its line was clear. Before she touched the key, the choir sang, “Clear until the ninth bell.” She transmitted the question anyway. Kingsfen received it and heard the same answer afterward.

Mr. Bell has barred tests involving private messages. He fears that operators will mistake a sung reply for a verified dispatch. Dr. Saye notes that the voices keep the rhythm of an old signaling practice abandoned after the Low Fell line closed.
